title: Pimp my fixpoint: sofic realization of multidimensional substitution-based shift spaces
summary: In symbolic dynamics, the fixed-point construction from arXiv:0910.2415 defines shift spaces of finite type whose configurations embed infinite hierarchies of tilings. This article provides a "black box" abstraction of this method phrased in terms of substitutions and $S$-adic limit spaces operating over sequences of increasingly large alphabets.
